name: firmware-ci
description: Replays the CI job that builds handheld firmware with act in its own containers, then checks the image's region, its deep-sleep wake and its BLE transmit setting.
lenses: the green tick on a masked failure
the OTA slot after next year's features
the wake pin the board routed
the hang with no reset path
the setting the grant was tested at
origin: written from four faults in a battery handheld's firmware: its CI had never built it, its board definition's flash layout disagreed with the bootloader, its deep sleep had no wake source, and nothing compared its Bluetooth transmit setting with the setting its radio module was tested at. Its controls are the pack's own ESP-IDF app; no project's design came with it.
